title: षोडशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 16 · The vision of Shiva and Uma

summary.en: Krishna tells how, bowing to the blazing light and then full of joy, he praised the Blessed Lord, and the gods too came to see him. He gives the praise that names Shiva as the lord of time, of death and of fire, the eternal source of time.
summary.kn: ಉರಿಯುವ ತೇಜಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ತಲೆ ಬಾಗಿ ಆನಂದದಿಂದ ಭಗವಂತನನ್ನು ಸ್ತುತಿಸಿದುದನ್ನು, ದೇವತೆಗಳೂ ಬಂದು ನೋಡಿದುದನ್ನು ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಶಿವ ಮೃತ್ಯು, ಯಮ, ಅಗ್ನಿ, ಕಾಲ, ಕಾಲದ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಮೂಲ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಿಸುವ ಸ್ತುತಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: कृष्ण बताते हैं कि उन्होंने दीप्त तेज को प्रणाम कर हर्ष से भगवान की स्तुति की और देवता भी दर्शन को आए। वे वह स्तुति देते हैं जिसमें शिव को मृत्यु, यम, अग्नि और काल तथा काल का शाश्वत स्रोत कहा गया है।
summary.te: జ్వలించే తేజస్సుకు నమస్కరించి ఆనందంతో భగవంతుని స్తుతించినట్లు, దేవతలు కూడా చూడవచ్చినట్లు కృష్ణుడు చెబుతాడు. శివుని మృత్యువు, యముడు, అగ్ని, కాలం, కాలానికి శాశ్వత మూలమని పేర్కొనే స్తుతిని ఇస్తాడు.
summary.ta: ஒளிரும் ஒளிக்குத் தலை வணங்கி மகிழ்ச்சியுடன் இறைவனைப் புகழ்ந்ததையும் தேவரும் வந்து கண்டதையும் கிருஷ்ணன் கூறுகிறார். சிவனை மரணம், யமன், நெருப்பு, காலம், காலத்தின் நிலையான மூலம் என்று பெயரிடும் துதியைத் தருகிறார்.
summary.ml: ജ്വലിക്കുന്ന പ്രകാശത്തിന് വണങ്ങിയശേഷം സന്തോഷത്തോടെ ഭഗവാനെ സ്തുതിച്ചതെങ്ങനെയെന്ന് കൃഷ്ണൻ പറയുന്നു; ദേവന്മാരും അദ്ദേഹത്തെ കാണാനെത്തി. കാലത്തിന്റെയും മൃത്യുവിന്റെയും അഗ്നിയുടെയും അധിപനും, കാലത്തിന്റെ ശാശ്വത ഉറവിടവുമായ ശിവനെ വാഴ്ത്തുന്ന സ്തുതിയും അദ്ദേഹം നൽകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.16; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: कृष्ण उवाच

meaning.en: Krishna said:

verses.text:
मूर्ध्ना निपत्य नियतस्तेजःसंनिचये ततः ।
परमं हर्षमागम्य भगवन्तमथाब्रुवम् ॥

meaning.en: I bowed my head to the ground before that mass of radiance, and filled with supreme joy, I then spoke to the Lord.

verses.text:
धर्मे दृढत्वं युधि शत्रुघातं
यशस्तथाग्र्यं परमं बलं च ।
योगप्रियत्वं तव संनिकर्षं
वृणे सुतानां च शतं शतानि ॥

meaning.en: I choose firmness in dharma, the slaying of foes in battle, the highest fame, supreme strength, a love of yoga, nearness to you, and hundreds of hundreds of sons.

verses.text: एवमस्त्विति तद्वाक्यं मयोक्तः प्राह शंकरः ॥

meaning.en: I said, 'So be it,' and Shankara answered my words.

verses.text:
ततो मां जगतो माता धरणी सर्वपावनी ।
उवाचोमा प्रणिहिता शर्वाणी तपसां निधिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Uma, the mother of the world, the earth, purifier of all, Sharvani, a treasure of austerities, composed and attentive, spoke to me.

verses.text:
दत्तो भगवता पुत्रः साम्बो नाम तवानघ ।
मत्तोऽप्यष्टौ वरानिष्टान्गृहाण त्वं ददामि ते ।
प्रणम्य शिरसा सा च मयोक्ता पाण्डुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: She said: 'The Lord has given you a son named Samba, sinless one. Take from me too eight boons you desire; I grant them.' I bowed my head to her, son of Pandu, and replied.

verses.text:
द्विजेष्वकोपं पितृतः प्रसादं
शतं सुतानामुपभोगं परं च ।
कुले प्रीतिं मातृतश्च प्रसादं
शमप्राप्तिं प्रवृणे चापि दाक्ष्यम् ॥

meaning.en: I said: 'I ask for freedom from anger toward brahmins, my father's grace, a hundred sons to enjoy, the best of comforts, affection in my family, my mother's grace, attainment of peace, and also skill.'

verses.text: देव्युवाच

meaning.en: The Goddess said:

verses.text:
एवं भविष्यत्यमरप्रभाव
नाहं मृषा जातु वदे कदाचित् ।
भार्यासहस्राणि च षोडशैव
तासु प्रियत्वं च तथाक्षयत्वम् ॥

meaning.en: 'So it shall be, you of divine power; I never speak falsely. You shall have sixteen thousand wives, and you will be dear to them and that love will never fade.

verses.text:
प्रीतिं चाग्र्यां बान्धवानां सकाशा-
द्ददामि ते वपुषः काम्यतां च ।
भोक्ष्यन्ते वै सप्ततिर्वै शतानि
गृहे तुभ्यमतिथीनां च नित्यम् ॥

meaning.en: I give you the highest affection from your kinsmen and a body that all find lovely. In your house, seven thousand guests will be fed every day.'

verses.text: वासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
एवं दत्त्वा वरान्देवो मम देवी च भारत ।
अन्तर्हितः क्षणे तस्मिन्सगणो भीमपूर्वज ॥

meaning.en: Having granted these boons, the God and the Goddess vanished in that instant with their attendants, Bharata, elder brother of Bhima.

verses.text:
एतदत्यद्भुतं सर्वं ब्राह्मणायातितेजसे ।
उपमन्यवे मया कृत्स्नमाख्यातं कौरवोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: All this utterly wondrous account I told in full to the brahmin Upamanyu of great radiance, best of the Kurus.

verses.text:
नमस्कृत्वा तु स प्राह देवदेवाय सुव्रत ।
नास्ति शर्वसमो दाने नास्ति शर्वसमो रणे ।
नास्ति शर्वसमो देवो नास्ति शर्वसमा गतिः ॥

meaning.en: Upamanyu bowed to the God of gods and said, 'Pious one, none equals Sharva in giving, none equals Sharva in battle, no god equals Sharva, and none is a refuge like Sharva.'

verses.text:
ऋषिरासीत्कृते तात तण्डिरित्येव विश्रुतः ।
दश वर्षसहस्राणि तेन देवः समाधिना ।
आराधितोऽभूद्भक्तेन तस्योदर्कं निशामय ॥

meaning.en: In the Krita age, dear one, there was a sage famed as Tandi. With a concentrated mind and devotion he worshipped the God for ten thousand years. Hear how it turned out.

verses.text:
स दृष्टवान्महादेवमस्तौषीच्च स्तवैर्विभुम् ।
पवित्राणां पवित्रस्त्वं गतिर्गतिमतां वर ।
अत्युग्रं तेजसां तेजस्तपसां परमं तपः ॥

meaning.en: He saw Mahadeva and praised the Lord with hymns: 'You are the purifier of purifiers, the best refuge of those who have refuge, the fiercest radiance among radiances, the supreme austerity among austerities.

verses.text:
विश्वावसुहिरण्याक्षपुरुहूतनमस्कृत ।
भूरिकल्याणद विभो पुरुसत्य नमोऽस्तु ते ॥

meaning.en: Honored by Vishvavasu, Hiranyaksha and Indra, giver of abundant blessings, all-pervading, truly great, homage to you.

verses.text:
जातीमरणभीरूणां यतीनां यततां विभो ।
निर्वाणद सहस्रांशो नमस्तेऽस्तु सुखाश्रय ॥

meaning.en: Lord, giver of liberation to ascetics who strive in fear of birth and death, thousand-rayed, abode of happiness, homage to you.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मा शतक्रतुर्विष्णुर्विश्वेदेवा महर्षयः ।
न विदुस्त्वां तु तत्त्वेन कुतो वेत्स्यामहे वयम् ॥

meaning.en: Brahma, Indra, Vishnu, the Vishvedevas and the great sages do not know you in truth; how then could we?

verses.text:
त्वत्तः प्रवर्तते कालस्त्वयि कालश्च लीयते ।
कालाख्यः पुरुषाख्यश्च ब्रह्माख्यश्च त्वमेव हि ॥

meaning.en: Time proceeds from you and dissolves in you; you alone are called Time, Purusha and Brahman.

verses.text:
तनवस्ते स्मृतास्तिस्रः पुराणज्ञैः सुरर्षिभिः ।
अधिपौरुषमध्यात्ममधिभूताधिदैवतम् ।
अधिलोक्याधिविज्ञानमधियज्ञस्त्वमेव हि ॥

meaning.en: Ancient sages and gods remember three forms of yours. You alone are the lord over persons, over the self, over beings, over the gods, over the worlds, over knowledge and over sacrifice.

verses.text:
त्वां विदित्वात्मदेहस्थं दुर्विदं दैवतैरपि ।
विद्वांसो यान्ति निर्मुक्ताः परं भावमनामयम् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing you, hard to know even for gods, as dwelling in one's own body, the wise are freed and reach the supreme, untroubled state.

verses.text:
अनिच्छतस्तव विभो जन्ममृत्युरनेकतः ।
द्वारं त्वं स्वर्गमोक्षाणामाक्षेप्ता त्वं ददासि च ॥

meaning.en: Lord, birth and death in many forms occur even against your wish; you are the door to heaven and liberation, you take away and you bestow.

verses.text:
त्वमेव मोक्षः स्वर्गश्च कामः क्रोधस्त्वमेव हि ।
सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव अधश्चोर्ध्वं त्वमेव हि ॥

meaning.en: You alone are liberation and heaven, desire and anger, sattva, rajas and tamas, and what is below and above.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च स्कन्देन्द्रौ सविता यमः ।
वरुणेन्दू मनुर्धाता विधाता त्वं धनेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: You are Brahma, Vishnu, Rudra, Skanda, Indra, Savita, Yama, Varuna, the Moon, Manu, Dhata, Vidhata and the lord of wealth.

verses.text:
भूर्वायुर्ज्योतिरापश्च वाग्बुद्धिस्त्वं मतिर्मनः ।
कर्म सत्यानृते चोभे त्वमेवास्ति च नास्ति च ॥

meaning.en: You are earth, air, light, water, speech, intellect, understanding and mind; action, truth and falsehood, both being and non-being.

verses.text:
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थाश्च तत्परं प्रकृतेर्ध्रुवम् ।
विश्वाविश्वपरो भावश्चिन्त्याचिन्त्यस्त्वमेव हि ॥

meaning.en: You are the senses and their objects, and the changeless beyond nature; you are the state that is beyond the universe and not beyond it, thinkable and unthinkable.

verses.text:
यच्चैतत्परमं ब्रह्म यच्च तत्परमं पदम् ।
या गतिः सांख्ययोगानां स भवान्नात्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: That which is the supreme Brahman, that supreme abode, the goal of Sankhya and Yoga, that you are, without doubt.

verses.text:
नूनमद्य कृतार्थाः स्म नूनं प्राप्ताः सतां गतिम् ।
यां गतिं प्राप्नुवन्तीह ज्ञाननिर्मलबुद्धयः ॥

meaning.en: Surely today we have fulfilled our aim, surely we have reached the refuge of the good, which those whose minds are cleansed by knowledge attain.

verses.text:
अहो मूढाः स्म सुचिरमिमं कालमचेतसः ।
यन्न विद्मः परं देवं शाश्वतं यं विदुर्बुधाः ॥

meaning.en: Ah, how foolish we have been, and for so long thoughtless, that we did not know the supreme eternal God whom the wise know!

verses.text:
सोऽयमासादितः साक्षाद्बहुभिर्जन्मभिर्मया ।
भक्तानुग्रहकृद्देवो यं ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: After many births I have now met him face to face, the God who is kind to devotees, knowing whom one tastes immortality.

verses.text:
देवासुरमनुष्याणां यच्च गुह्यं सनातनम् ।
गुहायां निहितं ब्रह्म दुर्विज्ञेयं सुरैरपि ॥

meaning.en: He is the eternal secret of gods, demons and men, Brahman hidden in the cave of the heart, hard for even the gods to know.

verses.text:
स एष भगवान्देवः सर्वकृत्सर्वतोमुखः ।
सर्वात्मा सर्वदर्शी च सर्वगः सर्ववेदिता ॥

meaning.en: This is the blessed God, maker of all, facing all directions, the self of all, all-seeing, all-pervading, all-knowing.

verses.text:
प्राणकृत्प्राणभृत्प्राणी प्राणदः प्राणिनां गतिः ।
देहकृद्देहभृद्देही देहभुग्देहिनां गतिः ॥

meaning.en: He makes life, sustains life, is a living being, gives life, and is the refuge of living beings; he makes bodies, bears bodies, is the embodied, enjoys bodies, and is the refuge of the embodied.

verses.text:
अध्यात्मगतिनिष्ठानां ध्यानिनामात्मवेदिनाम् ।
अपुनर्मारकामानां या गतिः सोऽयमीश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: He is the Lord who is the goal of those devoted to the path of the Self, of meditators and knowers of the Self, and of those who wish never to die again.

verses.text:
अयं च सर्वभूतानां शुभाशुभगतिप्रदः ।
अयं च जन्ममरणे विदध्यात्सर्वजन्तुषु ॥

meaning.en: He grants all beings their good or bad destinies, and he would ordain birth and death among all creatures.

verses.text:
अयं च सिद्धिकामानामृषीणां सिद्धिदः प्रभुः ।
अयं च मोक्षकामानां द्विजानां मोक्षदः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: He is the lord who grants success to sages desiring success, and who grants liberation to twice-born seekers of liberation.

verses.text:
भूराद्यान्सर्वभुवनानुत्पाद्य सदिवौकसः ।
विभर्ति देवस्तनुभिरष्टाभिश्च ददाति च ॥

meaning.en: Having created all the worlds beginning with Bhu and the heavens with their dwellers, the God sustains them and gives to them through his eight forms.

verses.text:
अतः प्रवर्तते सर्वमस्मिन्सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
अस्मिंश्च प्रलयं याति अयमेकः सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: From him everything proceeds, in him everything rests, and into him all dissolves; he alone is eternal.

verses.text:
अयं स सत्यकामानां सत्यलोकः परः सताम् ।
अपवर्गश्च मुक्तानां कैवल्यं चात्मवादिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: He is the Satya-loka, the highest, for the truthful and good; he is final release for the freed and absolute isolation for the knowers of the Self.

verses.text:
अयं ब्रह्मादिभिः सिद्धैर्गुहायां गोपितः प्रभुः ।
देवासुरमनुष्याणां न प्रकाशो भवेदिति ॥

meaning.en: He is the Lord whom Brahma and the perfected hid in the cave of the heart, so that he might not be revealed to gods, demons and men.

verses.text:
तं त्वां देवासुरनरास्तत्त्वेन न विदुर्भवम् ।
मोहिताः खल्वनेनैव हृच्छयेन प्रवेशिताः ॥

meaning.en: Gods, demons and men do not truly know you, Bhava; they are deluded by him who lies in the heart and who entered them.

verses.text:
ये चैनं संप्रपद्यन्ते भक्तियोगेन भारत ।
तेषामेवात्मनात्मानं दर्शयत्येष हृच्छयः ॥

meaning.en: Those who approach him with the discipline of devotion, Bharata, to them alone this heart-dweller shows himself as the Self.

verses.text:
यं ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्जन्म मरणं चापि विद्यते ।
यं विदित्वा परं वेद्यं वेदितव्यं न विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Knowing him there is no more birth or death, and knowing him there is nothing further to be known.

verses.text:
यं लब्ध्वा परमं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं पुनः ।
प्राणसूक्ष्मां परां प्राप्तिमागच्छत्यक्षयावहाम् ॥

meaning.en: Having gained him, one thinks no greater gain exists, and one reaches a supreme attainment, subtle as the breath, that never decays.

verses.text:
यं सांख्या गुणतत्त्वज्ञाः सांख्यशास्त्रविशारदाः ।
सूक्ष्मज्ञानरताः पूर्वं ज्ञात्वा मुच्यन्ति बन्धनैः ॥

meaning.en: Sankhya thinkers who know the truth of the gunas and are skilled in that science, delighting in subtle knowledge, know him and are freed from bonds.

verses.text:
यं च वेदविदो वेद्यं वेदान्तेषु प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
प्राणायामपरा नित्यं यं विशन्ति जपन्ति च ॥

meaning.en: Him whom Veda knowers, established in the Vedanta, as the thing to be known, and breath-control practitioners always enter and chant.

verses.text:
अयं स देवयानानामादित्यो द्वारमुच्यते ।
अयं च पितृयानानां चन्द्रमा द्वारमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He is said to be the sun, the door of the paths of the gods, and the moon, the door of the paths of the fathers.

verses.text:
एष कालगतिश्चित्रा संवत्सरयुगादिषु ।
भावाभावौ तदात्वे च अयने दक्षिणोत्तरे ॥

meaning.en: His is the varied course of time in years and ages, of coming to be and ceasing at each moment, and in the southern and northern solstices.

verses.text:
एवं प्रजापतिः पूर्वमाराध्य बहुभिः स्तवैः ।
वरयामास पुत्रत्वे नीललोहितसंज्ञितम् ॥

meaning.en: So Prajapati long ago, having worshipped him with many hymns, chose as his son the one named Nilalohita.

verses.text:
ऋग्भिर्यमनुशंसन्ति तन्त्रे कर्मणि बह्वृचः ।
यजुर्भिर्यं त्रिधा वेद्यं जुह्वत्यध्वर्यवोऽध्वरे ॥

meaning.en: Rig reciters praise him with the Rik verses in ritual, Adhvaryu priests offer to him in the sacrifice with the Yajus in three ways.

verses.text:
सामभिर्यं च गायन्ति सामगाः शुद्धबुद्धयः ।
यज्ञस्य परमा योनिः पतिश्चायं परः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: Sama singers of pure mind sing him with the Samans. He is called the supreme source and lord of sacrifice.

verses.text:
रात्र्यहःश्रोत्रनयनः पक्षमासशिरोभुजः ।
ऋतुवीर्यस्तपोधैर्यो ह्यब्दगुह्योरुपादवान् ॥

meaning.en: Night and day are his ears and eyes, fortnights and months his head and arms, the seasons his vigor, austerity and steadiness his support, the year his hidden parts, thighs and feet.

verses.text:
मृत्युर्यमो हुताशश्च कालः संहारवेगवान् ।
कालस्य परमा योनिः कालश्चायं सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: He is Death, Yama, the fire, and Time, swift in destruction; the supreme source of Time, and himself eternal Time.

verses.text:
चन्द्रादित्यौ सनक्षत्रौ सग्रहौ सह वायुना ।
ध्रुवः सप्तर्षयश्चैव भुवनाः सप्त एव च ॥

meaning.en: The moon and sun with the stars, the planets, the wind, the pole star, the seven sages and the seven worlds.

verses.text:
प्रधानं महदव्यक्तं विशेषान्तं सवैकृतम् ।
ब्रह्मादि स्तम्बपर्यन्तं भूतादि सदसच्च यत् ॥

meaning.en: Pradhana, Mahat, the unmanifest, the evolved forms through to the particulars, from Brahma down to a blade of grass, the elements and what is real and unreal.

verses.text:
अष्टौ प्रकृतयश्चैव प्रकृतिभ्यश्च यत्परम् ।
अस्य देवस्य यद्भागं कृत्स्नं संपरिवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: The eight primal natures and what is beyond those natures; all of this turns about as a portion of this God.

verses.text:
एतत्परममानन्दं यत्तच्छाश्वतमेव च ।
एषा गतिर्विरक्तानामेष भावः परः सताम् ॥

meaning.en: This is the supreme bliss, the eternal; this is the goal of the dispassionate and the highest state of the good.

verses.text:
एतत्पदमनुद्विग्नमेतद्ब्रह्म सनातनम् ।
शास्त्रवेदाङ्गविदुषामेतद्ध्यानं परं पदम् ॥

meaning.en: This is the state free from fear, this is eternal Brahman; for those learned in scripture and the Vedangas it is the highest object of meditation.

verses.text:
इयं सा परमा काष्ठा इयं सा परमा कला ।
इयं सा परमा सिद्धिरियं सा परमा गतिः ॥

meaning.en: This is the supreme limit, this the supreme fraction, this the supreme perfection, this the supreme goal.

verses.text:
इयं सा परमा शान्तिरियं सा निर्वृतिः परा ।
यं प्राप्य कृतकृत्याः स्म इत्यमन्यन्त वेधसः ॥

meaning.en: This is supreme peace, this the highest bliss, reaching which the creators thought, 'We have done what was to be done.'

verses.text:
इयं तुष्टिरियं सिद्धिरियं श्रुतिरियं स्मृतिः ।
अध्यात्मगतिनिष्ठानां विदुषां प्राप्तिरव्यया ॥

meaning.en: This is contentment, this is perfection, this is Shruti and Smriti; it is the imperishable attainment of the wise devoted to the path of the Self.

verses.text:
यजतां यज्ञकामानां यज्ञैर्विपुलदक्षिणैः ।
या गतिर्दैवतैर्दिव्या सा गतिस्त्वं सनातन ॥

meaning.en: The divine goal that the gods attain for those who sacrifice with lavish gifts, desiring sacrifice, that goal you are, eternal one.

verses.text:
जप्यहोमव्रतैः कृच्छ्रैर्नियमैर्देहपातनैः ।
तप्यतां या गतिर्देव वैराजे सा गतिर्भवान् ॥

meaning.en: The goal in the Vairaja realm for those who toil with chanting, offerings, vows, hard observances and mortifications, that goal you are, God.

verses.text:
कर्मन्यासकृतानां च विरक्तानां ततस्ततः ।
या गतिर्ब्रह्मभवने सा गतिस्त्वं सनातन ॥

meaning.en: The goal in Brahma's abode for those who have renounced action and are detached from everything, that goal you are, eternal one.

verses.text:
अपुनर्मारकामानां वैराग्ये वर्ततां परे ।
विकृतीनां लयानां च सा गतिस्त्वं सनातन ॥

meaning.en: The goal of those who desire not to die again and abide in supreme detachment, and of those dissolved into modifications, that goal you are, eternal one.

verses.text:
ज्ञानविज्ञाननिष्ठानां निरुपाख्या निरञ्जना ।
कैवल्या या गतिर्देव परमा सा गतिर्भवान् ॥

meaning.en: The indescribable, stainless, absolute goal for those devoted to knowledge and realization, that supreme goal you are, God.

verses.text:
वेदशास्त्रपुराणोक्ताः पञ्चैता गतयः स्मृताः ।
त्वत्प्रसादाद्धि लभ्यन्ते न लभ्यन्तेऽन्यथा विभो ॥

meaning.en: Five goals are declared in the Vedas, treatises and Puranas; they are gained by your grace, Lord, and not otherwise.

verses.text:
इति तण्डिस्तपोयोगात्तुष्टावेशानमव्ययम् ।
जगौ च परमं ब्रह्म यत्पुरा लोककृज्जगौ ॥

meaning.en: Thus Tandi, by the power of austerity, praised the imperishable Ishana, and sang the supreme Brahman that the maker of the worlds sang long ago.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मा शतक्रतुर्विष्णुर्विश्वेदेवा महर्षयः ।
न विदुस्त्वामिति ततस्तुष्टः प्रोवाच तं शिवः ॥

meaning.en: Saying, 'Brahma, Indra, Vishnu, the Vishvedevas and the great sages do not know you,' Tandi pleased Shiva, who then spoke to him.

verses.text:
अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव भविता दुःखवर्जितः ।
यशस्वी तेजसा युक्तो दिव्यज्ञानसमन्वितः ॥

meaning.en: Shiva said: 'You will be imperishable and undying, free of sorrow, glorious, radiant, and endowed with divine knowledge.

verses.text:
ऋषीणामभिगम्यश्च सूत्रकर्ता सुतस्तव ।
मत्प्रसादाद्द्विजश्रेष्ठ भविष्यति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: By my grace, best of brahmins, your son will be a composer of aphorisms and one whom sages will approach; there is no doubt.

verses.text:
कं वा कामं ददाम्यद्य ब्रूहि यद्वत्स काङ्क्षसे ।
प्राञ्जलिः स उवाचेदं त्वयि भक्तिर्दृढास्तु मे ॥

meaning.en: What wish shall I grant you today? Tell me what you desire, child.' With joined palms Tandi answered, 'Let my devotion to you be firm.'

verses.text:
एवं दत्त्वा वरं देवो वन्द्यमानः सुरर्षिभिः ।
स्तूयमानश्च विबुधैस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥

meaning.en: Having granted the boon, the God, honored by gods and sages and praised by the learned, vanished right there.

verses.text:
अन्तर्हिते भगवति सानुगे यादवेश्वर ।
ऋषिराश्रममागम्य ममैतत्प्रोक्तवानिह ॥

meaning.en: When the Lord and his attendants had vanished, lord of the Yadavas, the sage came to my hermitage and told me all this.

verses.text:
यानि च प्रथितान्यादौ तण्डिराख्यातवान्मम ।
नामानि मानवश्रेष्ठ तानि त्वं शृणु सिद्धये ॥

meaning.en: Best of men, now hear for your success those names, famed from the beginning, that Tandi told me.

verses.text:
दश नामसहस्राणि वेदेष्वाह पितामहः ।
शर्वस्य शास्त्रेषु तथा दश नामशतानि वै ॥

meaning.en: Brahma declared ten thousand names of Sharva in the Vedas, and a thousand in the treatises.

verses.text:
गुह्यानीमानि नामानि तण्डिर्भगवतोऽच्युत ।
देवप्रसादाद्देवेश पुरा प्राह महात्मने ॥

meaning.en: Acyuta, lord of gods, these secret names of the Blessed One were long ago told by Tandi, by the God's grace, to the great-souled one.
